scripts.db:up: yarn db:up:order && yarn db:up:inventory && yarn db:up:payment
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f order-catalog-service/docker-compose.db.yml down && docker compose -f inventory-service/docker-compose.db.yml down && docker compose -f payment-service/docker-compose.db.yml down
scripts.app:down: docker compose stop api-gateway-service order-catalog-service inventory-service payment-service frontend
scripts.containers:up: yarn infra:local && yarn db:up && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.containers:down: docker compose stop && yarn db:down && yarn infra:down
scripts.containers:reset: docker compose down && yarn db:down && docker compose -f docker-compose.infra.yml down
scripts.dev:local: yarn infra:local && yarn db:up && yarn app:down && concurrently -k -n api,order,inventory,payment,front -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow,blue "yarn dev:local:api" "yarn dev:local:order" "yarn dev:local:inventory" "yarn dev:local:payment" "yarn dev:local:frontend"

scripts.dev: yarn infra:local && yarn db:up && docker compose up -d --build && yarn deps:sync && yarn db:push && yarn migrate
scripts.dev:attach: yarn infra:local && yarn db:up && docker compose up --build
scripts.deps:sync: docker compose up -d --build api-gateway-service order-catalog-service inventory-service payment-service frontend && docker compose exec -T api-gateway-service npm install && docker compose exec -T order-catalog-service npm install && docker compose exec -T inventory-service npm install && docker compose exec -T payment-service npm install && docker compose exec -T frontend npm install && docker compose restart api-gateway-service order-catalog-service inventory-service payment-service frontend
scripts.db:push: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5432/order_catalog_db?schema=public npm.cmd --prefix ./order-catalog-service run prisma:push && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5433/inventory_db?schema=public npm.cmd --prefix ./inventory-service run prisma:push && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5434/payment_db?schema=public npm.cmd --prefix ./payment-service run prisma:push
scripts.db:reset:prisma: docker compose -f order-catalog-service/docker-compose.db.yml down -v && docker compose -f inventory-service/docker-compose.db.yml down -v && docker compose -f payment-service/docker-compose.db.yml down -v && yarn db:up && yarn db:push
scripts.migrate: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5432/order_catalog_db?schema=public npm.cmd --prefix ./order-catalog-service run prisma:deploy && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5433/inventory_db?schema=public npm.cmd --prefix ./inventory-service run prisma:deploy && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://root:password@localhost:5434/payment_db?schema=public npm.cmd --prefix ./payment-service run prisma:deploy
